attribution.note: Marcus's own first-person words on his own Substack.

semantics.note: Leaves out the 1998 warning and the Apple study framing, but the scored part is the persistence of the difficulty from 1998 to 2024. That is a fair observation to score.

contract.note: The plain reading is fair and ordinary: 'held steady' means the difficulty persisted, not that there was no progress. The contradiction condition sensibly requires the difficulty to have been broadly overcome.

evidence.note: 1998 analysis showing limited generalization for the parity architecture. It is task-specific and weak, but it is from the right period.
2018 SCAN study: RNNs fail at systematic compositional generalization on unfamiliar combinations.
Apple's October 2024 GSM-Symbolic study: LLM performance drops under small surface changes. This documents the difficulty in 2024.
2023 MLC result: systematic generalization achieved with special training. It qualifies a claim of total inability but does not show the difficulty was broadly overcome by 2024.

reviews.rationale: Independent studies from 1998, 2018 and 2024 document recurring failures to generalize to unfamiliar cases, and the 2024 Apple study shows the failures were still present. The 2023 MLC success is a specific, engineered advance and does not meet the contradiction condition of broad resolution. The 1998 evidence is thin and task-specific, but the persistence reading holds.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words. He cites Fortune but makes the observation himself.

semantics.note: Faithfully isolates the popularity observation from the separate claim of decades of advocacy.

contract.note: 'Coming into vogue' read as growing, visible research and industry attention, not dominance. This is a fair ordinary reading.

evidence.note: Peer-reviewed 2024 systematic review reports rapid growth in neuro-symbolic research since 2020.
Fortune feature of December 9, 2024 reports neurosymbolic work at SAP, IBM, Google and startups. The inspected version has a December 18 correction, still before the evaluation date.

reviews.rationale: A systematic review documents rapid research growth, and contemporaneous Fortune coverage reports activity at several organizations near the post date. Together they meet the support condition of growing attention plus visible coverage. The packet contains no evidence of stagnant or declining attention.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words. He characterizes what Nadella and Pichai said but does not quote them.

semantics.note: The normalized text makes 'new breakthroughs are needed' a general fact by most accounts. Marcus actually said Nadella and Pichai affirmed that need. The contract restores the attribution to the two CEOs.

contract.note: Splits the claim fairly into a scaling slowdown in late 2024 and statements by the two CEOs. It flags that Nadella's remarks could be read as a new form of scaling rather than a need for breakthroughs.

evidence.note: Pichai at DealBook: progress getting harder, 'deeper breakthroughs' needed. This matches the Pichai part.
Reuters, November 2024: Sutskever says pre-training scaling has plateaued, and labs are seeking new methods.

Nadella's Ignite transcript, a primary record of his words. He calls scaling laws empirical and welcomes architectural innovation, but stresses a new test-time scaling law. It only partly fits 'affirmed the need for breakthroughs'.
Altman's 'no wall' shows dissent. Because the claim says 'by most accounts', one dissenting voice does not contradict it.

reviews.rationale: Holds: prominent late-2024 reporting said pre-training scaling had plateaued, and Pichai explicitly said deeper breakthroughs were needed. Only partly holds: Nadella acknowledged the debate and invited architectural innovation, but framed progress as a new scaling law rather than affirming a need for breakthroughs.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his post.

semantics.note: Faithful three-part conjunction. The 'decade's promises' framing is properly treated as background.

contract.note: The readings are ordinary: public driverless service, nonzero hallucination, consumer-ready home humanoids. The 97% has no stated denominator, so that part depends on an interpretation Marcus did not supply.

evidence.note: OpenAI's o1 system card (December 5, 2024) reports nonzero hallucination rates. A company disclosure, but one against its own interest; it supports only the hallucination component.
Waymo's footprint covers four US cities. One operator's disclosure cannot establish a worldwide 97% figure.

reviews.rationale: The hallucination component is supported by the o1 system card. The packet has no global coverage inventory or denominator for the 97% figure, and no verified evidence on the consumer-ready home-humanoid market in December 2024. The conjunction therefore cannot be settled on this evidence.
